mutations.name: the table stops holding await-pr.ts, an importer of the sign-off rule
kills: the G10 hold table holds every Shepherd module that imports the hold, the sign-off rule or the release

mutations.name: the table stops holding tree-carry.ts, which the file-list reader imports
kills: the G10 hold table holds every file the hold, the sign-off rule and the release import, transitively

mutations.name: the table stops holding store.ts, the hold writer
kills: the G10 hold table holds store.ts, which writes or feeds the hold without a value import from a root

mutations.name: the table stops holding take-verdict.ts, the caller of grant-withheld.ts
kills: the G10 hold table holds take-verdict.ts, which writes or feeds the hold without a value import from a root

mutations.name: the panel stops being held whole
kills: the G10 hold table holds the panel module index.ts the hold and the sign-off run through
